title_en: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
title_zh: 救援人员称，俄罗斯空袭乌克兰后数小时，7 岁男孩从废墟中被救出
summary: Nine people are dead in the attack, with rescue efforts ongoing to find those still missing from the residential building.
summary_zh: 袭击造成九人死亡，救援工作正在进行中，以寻找住宅楼中失踪的人员。
body_en: A seven-year-old boy has been rescued from the rubble of a residential building in Dymer after 14 hours, in overnight Russian strikes on Dymer, in the Kyiv region, that killed nine people, Ukrainian officials have said.
The attack occurred in the early hours of Sunday. A 79-year-old woman was also rescued alive from the collapsed building, Kyiv's regional head Tymur Tkachenko said.
A strike on a private home in Bila Tserkva killed one more person and set the building ablaze, he added.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky also said three people were killed and 13 wounded in a separate strike on Vyshneve, also in the Kyiv region, that hit a grocery store on Sunday.
Ukrainian authorities said the boy in Dymer is in stable condition and was taken to hospital, and have thanked everyone involved in saving his life.
Zelensky and Ukraine's national police also confirmed the rescue of the boy.
Response teams including police, explosive technicians, dog handlers and medics are continuing with rescue efforts.
In a telegram post, Tkachenko said the 79-year-old woman rescued from the rubble was receiving treatment in hospital.
Earlier he said six people were injured in the attack, while others were still missing.
Image source, Ukraine State Emergency Service
Zelensky said more than 130 people are involved in emergency operations at the scene, and that they will continue until they have "complete information about every single person".
Sending his condolences to the families and loved ones of those killed, he said the strike struck the residential building, "practically blowing a section of it to smithereens".
Zelensky added that "rescue efforts are complicated by constant new air raid alerts and renewed threats".
The strike hit the building at 05:00 local time, when families were still asleep, Ukraine's minister of internal affairs Ivan Vyhivskyi said.
More than 70 strikes have been launched across 10 Ukrainian regions as of Sunday evening, Vyhivskyi added.
In his video address posted online, Zelensky also said three people were killed and 13 injured in a strike on an "ordinary grocery store" in Vyshneve.
Tkachenko previously said two other people were killed and eight wounded in the Vyshneve attack.
Russia also struck a power substation in the Dnipropetrovsk region, Ukraine's Prime Minister Sergiy Koretsky said in a post on X. , external
Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
body_zh: 乌克兰官员称，俄罗斯夜间对基辅地区代默尔发动空袭，造成 9 人死亡，14 小时后，一名 7 岁男孩从代默市一栋住宅楼的废墟中被救出。
袭击发生在周日凌晨。基辅地区负责人泰穆尔·特卡琴科 (Tymur Tkachenko) 表示，一名 79 岁的妇女也从倒塌的建筑物中被生还。
他补充说，白采尔科维一处私人住宅遭到袭击，造成一人死亡并导致建筑物起火。
乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基还表示，周日，基辅地区维什尼韦市的一家杂货店遭到袭击，造成 3 人死亡、13 人受伤。
乌克兰当局表示，戴默的男孩情况稳定，已被送往医院，并感谢所有参与挽救他生命的人。
泽连斯基和乌克兰国家警察也证实男孩获救。
包括警察、爆炸技术人员、训犬员和医务人员在内的响应小组正在继续开展救援工作。
特卡琴科在一份电报中表示，从废墟中救出的 79 岁妇女正在医院接受治疗。
早些时候他表示，袭击造成六人受伤，其他人仍下落不明。
图片来源，乌克兰国家紧急服务中心
泽伦斯基表示，超过 130 人正在现场参与紧急行动，他们将继续行动，直到掌握“每个人的完整信息”。
他向遇难者的家人和亲人表示哀悼，并表示袭击袭击了住宅楼，“实际上将其一部分炸成了碎片”。
泽伦斯基补充说，“由于不断出现新的空袭警报和新的威胁，救援工作变得更加复杂”。
乌克兰内政部长伊万·维希夫斯基 (Ivan Vyhivskyi) 表示，袭击发生在当地时间 05:00，当时人们还在熟睡中。
Vyhivskyi 补充说，截至周日晚间，乌克兰 10 个地区已发起 70 多次罢工。
泽连斯基在网上发布的视频讲话中还表示，维什尼韦一家“普通杂货店”遭到袭击，造成 3 人死亡、13 人受伤。
特卡琴科此前表示，维什涅夫袭击事件中另有两人死亡、八人受伤。
乌克兰总理谢尔盖·科列茨基在 X 上发帖称，俄罗斯还袭击了第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区的一座变电站。
俄罗斯于2022年对乌克兰发动全面入侵。

title_en: Russian warship sinks in Benghazi after suspected Ukrainian drone attack
title_zh: 疑似乌克兰无人机袭击后俄罗斯军舰在班加西沉没
summary: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a
summary_zh: 没有人声称对这艘在返回俄罗斯途中停靠的船只的袭击负责 一艘停靠在利比亚港口的俄罗斯军舰
body_en: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia

A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a dramatic night-time explosion and the sinking of the vessel.
The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette that had stopped to refuel and take on supplies, according to Libyan officials from the country’s eastern government.

Initial reports said several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, triggering the explosion, the officials told the Associated Press.

Satellite imagery showed the Merkury had sunk after the attack, which took place in the Mediterranean, more than 1,000 miles from south Ukraine , marking a notable geographic expansion of the now near five-year war.

Though Ukraine began the war with no navy, it has developed a sea drone capability that threatened Russian warships in the Black Sea. The Russian fleet has been forced to retreat to the eastern port of Novorossiysk because Sevastopol in occupied Crimea had become unsafe.

Hours later, a Russia-linked cargo ship said to be carrying military supplies, the Ascalon, was hit by a sea drone off the coast of Benghazi. Video showed the drone heading directly towards one end of the vessel, again causing a huge explosion.

Libyan naval forces ‌rescued the vessel’s crew, the ‌sources added. The health ministry said some crew members were in stable condition with minor injuries. The number of injured and their nationalities are not known.
Benghazi is controlled by the self-styled Libyan National Army, led by Gen Khalifa Haftar, which controls eastern and southern Libya and has been aligned with Russia.

There was no immediate reaction from Russian authorities, and no immediate claim of responsibility for the strike, but it comes as Ukrainian forces have stepped up their long-range attacks against Russia far beyond the frontlines.
The UN mission in Libya (Unsmil) expressed “serious concern” over the two drone attacks off Benghazi and called for “an immediate, independent and transparent investigation”, in a post on X.

The ‌eastern-based Libyan authority said port and naval base facilities, including warehouses, were safe and that ​normal operations would resume once the fire was brought under control and the site secured.
It condemned the suspected attack as a violation of Libya’s sovereignty and ⁠a threat to maritime safety, saying it would take ​legal and ​diplomatic measures against ​anyone found responsible.
“The Libyan government will not ​allow Libyan ‌ports, territory or territorial ​waters ​to be turned into an arena for settling scores or exporting international conflicts,” it said.

The specialist website Naval News earlier identified the ship attacked as the Merkury, a Russian corvette – the smallest class of warship, smaller than a frigate – and said it had almost certainly been destroyed.

HI Sutton, a naval analyst, said the attack was probably conducted by sea drones, after a photograph of one emerged apparently taken off the Libyan coast. The drone, he said, “is also likely the type used in the subsequent attack”. Similar-looking drones were involved in the subsequent attack on the Ascalon cargo ship.

If it is confirmed that Ukraine has been able to blow up or seriously damage a Russian warship in Benghazi, it would represent one of its most successful naval strikes during the almost five-year war.
But it also represents a risky extension of the fighting far beyond eastern Europe, in an incident that could affect civilians on another continent and the working of the port.

A small unit of Ukrainian special forces operatives has been based at Misrata, western Libya, and is believed to have coordinated drone attacks on Russian tankers and transport ships in the past year.
body_zh: 没有人声称对这艘在返回俄罗斯途中停靠的船只的袭击负责
周日凌晨，一艘停靠在利比亚港口城市班加西的俄罗斯军舰在疑似乌克兰海上无人机袭击中被击中，导致夜间剧烈爆炸并导致船只沉没。
利比亚东部政府官员表示，这次袭击严重损坏了俄罗斯海军护卫舰“水星”号，该护卫舰当时已停下来加油和补给。
初步报道称，几架乌克兰海上无人机向这艘船发射。官员们告诉美联社，至少四架无人机被拦截并摧毁，其中两架击中了军舰，引发了爆炸。
卫星图像显示，这次袭击发生在距离乌克兰南部1000多英里的地中海，水星号已经沉没，这标志着近五年战争的地理范围显着扩大。
尽管乌克兰在没有海军的情况下开始战争，但它已经发展了海上无人机能力，威胁黑海的俄罗斯军舰。由于被占领的克里米亚塞瓦斯托波尔变得不安全，俄罗斯舰队被迫撤退到新罗西斯克东部港口。
几小时后，一艘据称载有军事物资的与俄罗斯有关的货船阿斯卡隆号在班加西海岸被一架海上无人机击中。视频显示，无人机直接飞向船只的一端，再次引发巨大爆炸。
消息人士补充说，利比亚海军营救了该船的船员。卫生部表示，一些船员受轻伤，情况稳定。受伤人数及其国籍尚不清楚。
班加西由哈利法·哈夫塔尔将军领导的自封的利比亚国民军控制，该军控制着利比亚东部和南部，并与俄罗斯结盟。
俄罗斯当局没有立即做出反应，也没有立即声称对这次袭击负责，但与此同时，乌克兰军队已经加强了对远离前线的俄罗斯的远程攻击。
联合国驻利比亚特派团 (Unsmil) 在 X 上发帖，对班加西附近的两起无人机袭击表示“严重关切”，并呼吁“立即进行独立和透明的调查”。
总部位于东部的利比亚当局表示，包括仓库在内的港口和海军基地设施是安全的，一旦火势得到控制并确保现场安全，就会恢复正常运营。
它谴责这起疑似袭击事件侵犯了利比亚的主权，并对海上安全构成威胁，并表示将对任何责任人采取法律和外交措施。
声明称：“利比亚政府不会允许利比亚港口、领土或领海成为算账或输出国际冲突的竞技场。”
专业网站《海军新闻》早些时候确认，这艘遭到袭击的船只是俄罗斯护卫舰“水星号”——最小级别的军舰，比护卫舰还要小——并表示它几乎肯定已被摧毁。
海军分析家萨顿 (HI Sutton) 表示，这次袭击可能是由海上无人机实施的，因为一张照片显然是在利比亚海岸拍摄的。他说，这架无人机“也可能是随后袭击中使用的类型”。类似的无人机参与了随后对阿斯卡隆货船的袭击。
如果确认乌克兰能够在班加西炸毁或严重损坏一艘俄罗斯军舰，这将是近五年战争中乌克兰最成功的海上打击之一。
但这也代表着战斗有可能延伸到东欧以外的地区，这一事件可能会影响另一个大陆的平民和港口的运作。
乌克兰特种部队的一小支部队驻扎在利比亚西部的米苏拉塔，据信在过去一年里协调无人机袭击了俄罗斯油轮和运输船。

title_en: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
title_zh: 驶往俄罗斯的船只在芬兰湾遭遇袭击
summary: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.
summary_zh: 芬兰国防军表示，乌克兰很可能是无人机袭击该船的幕后黑手。
body_en: A Russian cargo vessel that was hit by a drone attack in the eastern Gulf of Finland is being towed away, authorities have said.
The Sparta II had been bound for Russia's Baltic exclave Kaliningrad when it was hit on Saturday morning, sparking a fire aboard.
It then drifted into Finnish waters and its crew were evacuated to Russia. Finnish defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind the attack. Kyiv has yet to comment.
Finland's Border Guard said on Sunday afternoon that fire was no longer visible from the outside but thermal cameras showed that some containers on the ship were still warm.
The Sparta II was "slightly listing", Finnish authorities added, but the "situation is stable" and no fuel or other "hazardous substance leaks" had been detected.
Kaliningrad Governor Alexei Besprozvannykh said two drones appeared to have been used in the strike and that there was "no threat" to his territory's supplies.
The Sparta II was sanctioned by the US in 2022 and Ukraine earlier this year, and is run by a Russian company, according to the Ukrainian and US governments.
The company says it was established within the structure of Russia's defence ministry in 2011 and since 2015 has been operating within the military construction complex.

Finland's coast guard said it had been alerted to the attack at around 08:50 local time (06:50 GMT) on Saturday and that the cargo vessel had been located approximately 50km west of the island of Suursaari in the Gulf of Finland.
This prompted "temporary aviation and maritime restrictions" around the area, Finnish border officials said.
"War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity," Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said. "Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor."
Shortly after the incident, Finland's defence ministry said a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating the country's airspace, potentially linked to "rescue or tracking operations".

While Besprozvannykh initially said the crew of the Sparta II intended to repair the ship and carry on their journey, the Finnish Border Guard later said they had been evacuated to another Russian vessel that was en route to Russia.
Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti, director of maritime operations at the Finnish Border Guard, said during a news conference on Sunday that one Sparta II crew member had suffered minor injuries.
The Russian rescue vessel Murman is leading towing operations with the support of a Finnish guard ship and a Estonian naval patrol vessel.
Kaliningrad is a Russian exclave that sits between Poland and Lithuania.
Finnish Defence Minister Antti Häkkänen said that the Border Guard was responsible for the investigation into the attack and was co-operating with other relevant authorities.
Nato has also been informed, the defence ministry said.

The Baltic Sea has become a flashpoint in the Russia-Ukraine war, triggered when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Ukraine has recently ramped up its long-range attacks against Russia beyond the front lines.
Earlier this month, a Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland .
body_zh: 当局表示，一艘在芬兰湾东部遭受无人机袭击的俄罗斯货船正在被拖走。
周六早上，斯巴达二号原本开往俄罗斯波罗的海飞地加里宁格勒，遭到撞击，导致船上起火。
随后漂入芬兰水域，船员被疏散至俄罗斯。芬兰国防军表示，乌克兰很可能是此次袭击的幕后黑手。基辅尚未发表评论。
芬兰边防卫队周日下午表示，从外部看不到火势，但热像仪显示船上的一些集装箱仍然温暖。
芬兰当局补充说，斯巴达二号“轻微倾斜”，但“情况稳定”，没有发现燃料或其他“危险物质泄漏”。
加里宁格勒州长阿列克谢·贝斯普罗兹万内赫表示，袭击中似乎使用了两架无人机，他所在地区的供应“没有受到威胁”。
据乌克兰和美国政府称，Sparta II 于 2022 年受到美国和今年早些时候乌克兰的制裁，由一家俄罗斯公司运营。
该公司表示，它于 2011 年在俄罗斯国防部的框架内成立，自 2015 年以来一直在军事建筑群内运营。
芬兰海岸警卫队表示，已于周六当地时间 08:50（格林威治标准时间 06:50）左右接到袭击警报，该货船位于芬兰湾 Suursaari 岛以西约 50 公里处。
芬兰边境官员表示，这促使该地区周围出现“临时航空和海上限制”。
芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波表示：“战争正在蔓延到我们附近。” “乌克兰有权反击侵略者。”
事件发生后不久，芬兰国防部表示，一架俄罗斯直升机涉嫌侵犯该国领空，可能与“救援或追踪行动”有关。
虽然贝斯普罗兹万尼赫最初表示，斯巴达二号的船员打算修理该船并继续他们的旅程，但芬兰边防卫队后来表示，他们已被疏散到另一艘正在前往俄罗斯的俄罗斯船只上。
芬兰边防卫队海上行动主任尤卡-佩卡·卢米拉蒂在周日的新闻发布会上表示，一名斯巴达二号船员受轻伤。
俄罗斯救援船“摩尔曼”号在一艘芬兰警卫船和一艘爱沙尼亚海军巡逻艇的支持下主导拖航行动。
加里宁格勒是位于波兰和立陶宛之间的俄罗斯飞地。
芬兰国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁表示，边防卫队负责对袭击事件进行调查，并正在与其他有关当局合作。
国防部表示，北约也已获悉此事。
波罗的海已成为俄乌战争的爆发点，起因是俄罗斯于2022年对乌克兰发动全面入侵。乌克兰最近加大了对俄罗斯前线以外地区的远程攻击力度。
本月早些时候，乌克兰无人机袭击了芬兰湾的一艘俄罗斯军舰。

title_en: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
title_zh: 官员称利比亚港口俄罗斯船只爆炸疑似无人机袭击造成
summary: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.
summary_zh: 利比亚东部政府表示，这艘船在返回俄罗斯的途中停下来补充燃料和补给。
body_en: By Hafsa Khalil and Joe Inwood , World news correspondent
An explosion on a Russian ship docked at Benghazi naval base was caused by a suspected drone attack, Libya's eastern government has said.
The explosion happened at dawn on Sunday, while the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia, Libya state media reported, citing the eastern government.
The statement said there were no casualties. Moscow has yet to comment.

Later on Sunday, the health ministry said it had received injured people from another vessel, a commercial ship, that was also targeted off the coast of Benghazi, state media reported. Their injuries were minor and their condition stable, the ministry said.
The UN mission in Libya expressed "serious concern" over the attacks, calling for "an immediate, independent and transparent investigation".
"Libya cannot afford, and must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts," the UNSMIL wrote on X. , external

Videos posted on social media and geolocated by BBC Verify show the ship that was struck in the morning engulfed in flames and smoke. Satellite imagery from Planet Labs PBC also shows a boat on fire at 05:47 GMT at the Benghazi port.

US-based intelligence firm Vantor collected high-resolution images that it said showed Project 20380 Steregushchiy-class corvette (Merkury) - a Russian navy ship - moored in the port on Saturday, and on Sunday showed most of the same ship capsized and sunk with only the forward bow still visible.

The eastern-based Government of National Stability (GNS) said the Russian ship - which it did not name or identify - was using the Benghazi port within the framework of an existing maritime agreement.
Sunday's incident is under investigation, and authorities are coordinating with their Russian counterparts to determine the source of the suspected attack and who is responsible for it, GNS added.

GNS condemned the attack on a ship inside a Libyan port, and called it a violation of maritime safety and an attack on their sovereignty. It said Libya was not party to the Russia-Ukraine war, or any other conflict beyond its borders.

Separately, Libya's internationally recognised government in Tripoli - the Government of National Unity (GNU) - warned against hosting foreign forces and allowing them to use facilities in a statement published by state media.

GNU said such activity raises "serious fears" about "risks that may result from involving ports and civilian facilities in activities related to external conflicts, and the resulting threat to the lives of citizens and the safety of national facilities and assets".
Libya fractured into violence and instability after its leader Muammar Gaddafi was overthrown in 2011, leading to the opposing governments.
Benghazi is more than 2,000 km (1,243 miles) away from the Russian capital Moscow.
Although it has not been officially confirmed who was behind the attack, there is little doubt, according to Jalel Harchaoui, Libya specialist at the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI).
"Ukraine is the only actor brazen enough to pull something like that off," he told the BBC. "If I were to bet my own money, I would bet that it was the Ukrainians."

If confirmed, it would not be the first time Ukrainian forces had carried out an operation of this sort. In March, Russia accused Ukraine of targeting the Russian tanker Arctic Metagaz in the Mediterranean between Libya and Malta with "uncrewed sea drones" launched from the Libyan coast.

As well as having an economic impact on Russia, hampering the ability of their so-called shadow fleet of tankers to export oil and gas, attacks like this are seen as humiliating to the Kremlin, according to Harchaoui.
body_zh: 作者：哈夫萨·哈利勒和乔·因伍德，世界新闻通讯员
利比亚东部政府表示，一艘停靠在班加西海军基地的俄罗斯船只发生爆炸，疑似由无人机袭击引起。
利比亚官方媒体援引东部政府的消息称，爆炸发生在周日黎明，当时该船在返回俄罗斯的途中停下来补充燃料和补给。
声明称，没有人员伤亡。莫斯科尚未发表评论。
据官方媒体报道，周日晚些时候，卫生部表示，已从另一艘商船上接收了受伤人员，这艘商船也在班加西海岸附近遭到袭击。卫生部表示，他们的伤势较轻，情况稳定。
联合国驻利比亚代表团对袭击表示“严重关切”，呼吁“立即进行独立和透明的调查”。
联利支助团在 X 上写道：“利比亚无力承受，也绝不能成为外国冲突的战场。”
社交媒体上发布并由 BBC verify 进行地理定位的视频显示，早上被击中的船只被火焰和烟雾吞没。来自 PBC 星球实验室的卫星图像还显示，格林威治标准时间 05:47，班加西港口的一艘船起火。
美国情报公司 Vantor 收集的高分辨率图像显示，周六停泊在港口的俄罗斯海军舰艇 20380 号项目 Steregushchiy 级护卫舰（水星号），周日显示该舰的大部分倾覆并沉没，仅前部船头仍可见。
东部国家稳定政府（GNS）表示，这艘俄罗斯船只正在现有海事协议框架内使用班加西港，但没有透露该船只的名称或身份。
GNS 补充说，周日的事件正在调查中，当局正在与俄罗斯同行协调，以确定可疑袭击的来源以及责任人。
GNS谴责对利比亚港口内一艘船只的袭击，称这是对海上安全的侵犯和对其主权的攻击。声明称，利比亚没有参与俄罗斯-乌克兰战争或任何其他境外冲突。
另外，利比亚国际公认的的黎波里政府——民族团结政府（GNU）——在官方媒体发表的一份声明中警告不要接待外国军队并允许他们使用设施。
GNU表示，此类活动引发了“严重担忧”，即“港口和民用设施参与与外部冲突有关的活动可能带来的风险，以及由此对公民生命和国家设施和资产的安全造成的威胁”。
2011 年领导人卡扎菲被推翻后，利比亚陷入暴力和不稳定，导致了对立政府的产生。
班加西距俄罗斯首都莫斯科 2,000 多公里（1,243 英里）。
皇家联合军种研究所 (RUSI) 利比亚问题专家贾勒尔·哈查维 (Jalel Harchaoui) 表示，虽然尚未正式确认此次袭击的幕后黑手是谁，但毫无疑问。
“乌克兰是唯一一个厚颜无耻地做出这样的事情的演员，”他告诉英国广播公司。 “如果我用自己的钱打赌，我会打赌是乌克兰人。”
如果得到证实，这将不是乌克兰军队第一次进行此类行动。今年3月，俄罗斯指责乌克兰从利比亚海岸发射“无人海上无人机”，瞄准利比亚和马耳他之间地中海的俄罗斯油轮Arctic Metagaz。
哈沙维表示，此类袭击不仅对俄罗斯产生经济影响，阻碍其所谓影子油轮船队出口石油和天然气的能力，还被视为对克里姆林宫的侮辱。

title_en: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory
title_zh: 乌克兰战争蔓延至北约领土
summary: The war between Russia and Ukraine once again creeps onto European territory – from attacks on ships to missiles in Poland and fresh allegations of Russian operations inside Denmark.
summary_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争再次蔓延到欧洲领土——从袭击船只到波兰的导弹，再到对俄罗斯的新指控
body_en: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory The war between Russia and Ukraine once again creeps onto European territory – from attacks on ships to missiles in Poland and fresh allegations of Russian operations inside Denmark.
The war between Russia and Ukraine once again creeps onto European territory – from attacks on ships to missiles in Poland and fresh allegations of Russian operations inside Denmark.

A Russian ship was set ablaze after it was struck by a drone in the Baltic Sea. Yet another sign that the war in Ukraine is, at times, spilling over into the rest of Europe. This comes just days after President Trump called Russian President Vladimir Putin his friend. Teri Schultz joins us now from Brussels. Teri, let's start in the Gulf of Finland. A Russian cargo ship was hit by a drone there Saturday and caught fire. What's the latest on that?

TERI SCHULTZ, BYLINE: Well, a few hours ago, Rob, Russia took control of this cargo ship, the Sparta II, and towed it out of Finnish waters a day after, as you mentioned, it was hit by a drone. The crew was rescued by another Russian vessel traveling nearby at the time of the strike. Now, the attack is presumed to have come from Ukraine, but Kyiv has not yet claimed responsibility. Finnish President Alexander Stubb referred to the incident as an unfortunate reminder that the, quote, "consequences of Russia's war of aggression are also visible in our region." Interestingly, teams from both Finland and neighboring Estonia came Saturday and helped Russian ships try to put out the fire on board. Stubb thanked all of those involved for what he called responsible and professional actions.
SCHMITZ: So if the Sparta II was in the service of the Russian military, why didn't Finland seize the ship to put it out of business?

SCHULTZ: There was a lot of talk about this in Finland because this ship transports weapons and other supplies to Russia to use against Ukraine. And the vessel itself is under U.S. and U.K. sanctions, and its owner is under European Union sanctions. But the conclusion this time was that it would create too big an environmental hazard to keep it in Finnish waters. Here's how it was described in a press conference by Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti, the director of sea operations for the Finnish Border Guard.
JUKKA-PEKKA LUMILAHTI: (Through interpreter) If we would let the vessel burn, it would most likely sink. And after that, it would cause a major environmental risk for Finland and Estonia.
SCHULTZ: So as much as Finland would be pleased to take a military cargo ship out of Moscow's arsenal, in this case, they were basically saying good riddance.

SCHMITZ: So Ukraine is not the only one launching far-reaching strikes. Last Friday, Russia launched missiles into Polish territory. And I understand that you were there covering a nearby military exercise involving nearly a dozen countries, and it was that that was suspected to be Russia's reason for doing this, right?

SCHULTZ: Yeah, that's right. There were three Russian cruise missiles that landed between 30 and 60 miles from this military exercise, which was training forces for what's envisioned to eventually be a peace-monitoring mission in post-war Ukraine. At the time, all we knew on the ground was that there were multiple air alerts, at one time even telling us to take cover. And that happens often in Poland, especially at that location just over a hundred miles from the Ukrainian border. But this is particularly risky for the Russians, as they never know whether they'll kill people from a NATO country on the ground. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte was asked by a crowd of reporters in Warsaw whether the alliance can do anything to stop these Russian incursions.

MARK RUTTE: I cannot guarantee you that it will not happen. But I can guarantee you is that NATO will defend every inch of Polish territory, that as a collective alliance, we impose immense costs on Russians.
SCHULTZ: Now, Rob, NATO ambassadors will meet Monday morning in a special session to discuss what more their countries may be able to do to protect Poland.
SCHMITZ: That is Teri Schultz in Brussels. Teri, thanks so much for your reporting.

body_zh: 乌克兰战争蔓延到北约领土俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争再次蔓延到欧洲领土——从对波兰船只的袭击到导弹袭击，再到对俄罗斯在丹麦境内行动的新指控。
俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争再次蔓延到欧洲领土——从波兰的船只袭击到导弹袭击，再到俄罗斯在丹麦境内行动的新指控。
一艘俄罗斯船只在波罗的海被无人机击中后起火。另一个迹象表明，乌克兰战争有时会蔓延到欧洲其他地区。就在几天前，特朗普总统称俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京为朋友。泰瑞·舒尔茨 (Teri Schultz) 现在从布鲁塞尔加入我们。泰瑞，我们从芬兰湾开始吧。周六，一艘俄罗斯货船在那里被一架无人机击中并起火。最新消息是什么？

泰瑞·舒尔茨连线：几个小时前，罗布，俄罗斯控制了这艘货船“斯巴达二号”，并在一天后将其拖离芬兰水域，正如您提到的，它被一架无人机击中。袭击发生时，船员被附近行驶的另一艘俄罗斯船只救起。现在，袭击被推测来自乌克兰，但基辅尚未声称对此负责。芬兰总统亚历山大·斯塔布称这一事件不幸地提醒人们，“俄罗斯侵略战争的后果在我们地区也显而易见”。有趣的是，来自芬兰和邻国爱沙尼亚的团队周六抵达，帮助俄罗斯船只试图扑灭船上的大火。斯塔布感谢所有相关人员采取的负责任和专业的行动。
施密茨：那么，如果斯巴达二号是为俄罗斯军队服务的，为什么芬兰没有扣押这艘船并使其停业呢？
舒尔茨：芬兰对此进行了很多讨论，因为这艘船向俄罗斯运送武器和其他物资，用于对抗乌克兰。该船本身受到美国和英国的制裁，其船东也受到欧盟的制裁。但这次的结论是，将其留在芬兰水域会造成太大的环境危害。芬兰边防卫队海上行动总监尤卡-佩卡·卢米拉蒂 (Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti) 在新闻发布会上是这样描述的。
JUKKA-PEKKA LUMILAHTI：（通过翻译）如果我们让船只燃烧，它很可能会沉没。此后，这将对芬兰和爱沙尼亚造成重大环境风险。
舒尔茨：尽管芬兰很乐意从莫斯科的军火库中取出一艘军用货船，但在这种情况下，他们基本上是在说好摆脱。
施密茨：所以乌克兰并不是唯一发动影响深远的袭击的国家。上周五，俄罗斯向波兰境内发射了导弹。据我了解，你当时正在现场报道附近有近十几个国家参加的军事演习，这被怀疑是俄罗斯这样做的原因，对吗？

舒尔茨：是的，没错。三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹落在距这次军事演习 30 至 60 英里的地方，此次演习旨在训练部队，以执行最终在战后乌克兰执行的和平监测任务。当时，我们只知道地面上有多次空中警报，甚至有一次告诉我们要隐蔽。这种情况在波兰经常发生，尤其是在距离乌克兰边境仅一百多英里的地方。但这对俄罗斯人来说尤其危险，因为他们永远不知道自己是否会杀死来自北约国家的人。北约秘书长马克·吕特在华沙被一群记者询问北约是否可以采取措施阻止俄罗斯的入侵。
马克·鲁特：我不能向你保证这不会发生。但我可以向你们保证，北约将保卫每一寸波兰领土，作为一个集体联盟，我们给俄罗斯人带来了巨大的代价。
舒尔茨：现在，罗布，北约大使将于周一上午召开特别会议，讨论他们的国家可以采取哪些措施来保护波兰。
施密茨：那是布鲁塞尔的泰瑞·舒尔茨。泰瑞，非常感谢您的报告。

title_en: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order
title_zh: 美国陆军不顾法院命令在爱荷华州引爆数吨不稳定爆炸物
summary: The Army says "swift action" is necessary to protect its personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant in Iowa.
summary_zh: 陆军表示，有必要采取“迅速行动”来保护爱荷华州弹药厂周围的人员和附近社区。
body_en: The US Army plans to move ahead with detonating five tonnes of degraded explosives in Iowa despite a ruling to halt it indefinitely, a new court filing shows.

"To protect its personnel and the surrounding communities, the Army needs to take swift action," the justice department notified the court on Saturday. "Protection of human health and the environment demand action now, not delay."
The court had ordered a pause after environmental groups sued to stop the detonation, arguing the army failed to consider safer alternatives.
The detonation was originally scheduled for Friday at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown. The army now plans to act by 24 November under an emergency exemption.

In the new filing, the Department of the Army argued that a controlled detonation was necessary to protect the public from an unplanned explosion, a risk it said would become more likely as temperatures were set to fall in the coming days.

"There is an immediate risk that the lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant will explode as temperatures are expected to drop below 30 degrees Fahrenheit (-1C) in the next several days," the filing states.
It argued that the army had removed the doors to the bunker where the barrels were stored in preparation for the detonation and that made the explosives more "vulnerable to temperature changes".
The government has not released details for the rescheduled detonation.

Earlier, the army had warned residents to leave their homes for six hours on the original scheduled day of the explosion, for the duration of the explosion and until the dust settled. An advisory warned "all humans" to avoid being outside in the affected areas while the demolition detonation was set to take place.

Lead azide is a highly volatile compound used as a detonator. Earlier this year, the IAAAP found that the material had degraded over time to the point where it was now too risky to move the material, according to Iowa Public Radio.
On Friday, the military said it was working with the Department of Health and Human Services and the EPA to ensure the explosion was done in the safest manner possible.
Military and environmental officials determined that detonating it in place was the safest way to eliminate the explosive safety hazard.

The EPA, which granted an emergency permit to detonate 68 drums of the material, said it did so because the explosion risk "presented an imminent and substantial threat to human health and the environment".

One of the Environmental groups suing to pause the detonation, the Iowa Environmental Council, argued that many Iowans living within the risk-zone were unaware that the explosion was scheduled to happen.
"There is no safe level of lead exposure, and Iowans were given just days to prepare for the November 20 detonation," the organisation said in a press statement.
The Iowa Environmental Council and Sierra Club, which filed the lawsuit on Thursday that prompted the court-ordered pause, filed a new motion on Sunday in response to the army's filing.
The group asks the court to pause proceedings so that it may submit additional information before the scheduled detonation.

The motion includes declarations from environmental experts and local officials who support pausing the detonation, citing a lack of public notice and questioning the Army's claim that delay would cause significant risks.

body_zh: 一份新的法庭文件显示，美国陆军计划继续在爱荷华州引爆 5 吨已降解的爆炸物，尽管已裁定无限期停止该行动。
“为了保护其人员和周围社区，陆军需要迅速采取行动，”司法部周六通知法院。 “保护人类健康和环境需要立即采取行动，而不是拖延。”
在环保组织提起诉讼要求停止爆炸后，法院下令暂停爆炸，理由是军队未能考虑更安全的替代方案。
爆炸原定于周五在米德尔敦的爱荷华州陆军弹药厂进行。陆军现在计划在 11 月 24 日之前根据紧急豁免采取行动。
在新提交的文件中，陆军部辩称，有必要进行受控爆炸，以保护公众免受意外爆炸的影响，并表示，随着未来几天气温下降，这种风险将变得更大。
文件称：“由于预计未来几天气温将降至 30 华氏度 (-1C) 以下，爱荷华州陆军弹药厂的叠氮化铅将面临爆炸的直接风险。”
它认为，军队已经拆除了存放桶的掩体的门，以准备爆炸，这使得炸药更“容易受到温度变化的影响”。
政府尚未公布重新安排的爆炸的细节。
早些时候，军方警告居民在原定爆炸当天离开家六小时，直至爆炸持续时间直至尘埃落定。一份警告警告“所有人”在拆除爆炸即将发生时避免前往受影响地区。
叠氮化铅是一种用作雷管的高挥发性化合物。据爱荷华州公共广播电台报道，今年早些时候，IAAP 发现这些材料随着时间的推移已经降解，现在移动这些材料的风险太大。
周五，军方表示正在与卫生与公众服务部和美国环保局合作，确保爆炸以尽可能安全的方式进行。
军方和环境官员确定，就地引爆是消除爆炸安全隐患的最安全方法。
美国环保局授予了引爆 68 桶这种材料的紧急许可证，并表示这样做是因为爆炸风险“对人类健康和环境构成迫在眉睫的重大威胁”。
爱荷华州环境委员会是起诉暂停爆炸的环保组织之一，该委员会辩称，许多生活在危险区域内的爱荷华州人并不知道爆炸预定会发生。
该组织在一份新闻声明中表示，“铅暴露没有安全水平，爱荷华州只有几天时间为 11 月 20 日的爆炸做好准备”。
爱荷华州环境委员会和塞拉俱乐部于周四提起诉讼，促使法院下令暂停，并于周日提出了一项新动议，以回应军队的诉讼。
该组织要求法院暂停诉讼程序，以便在预定的爆炸之前提交更多信息。
该动议包括环境专家和地方官员的声明，他们支持暂停爆炸，理由是缺乏公众通知，并质疑陆军关于推迟爆炸会造成重大风险的说法。

title_en: Belgium’s airports set to shut down due to anti-austerity strike
title_zh: 比利时机场因反紧缩罢工而关闭
summary: Skeyes halts air traffic control services, grounding flights at Belgian airports amid union-led strike.
summary_zh: 在工会领导的罢工中，斯基斯停止了空中交通管制服务，并停飞了比利时机场的航班。
body_en: Belgium’s airports set to shut down due to anti-austerity strike | Protests News | Al Jazeera
Share Belgium’s airports set to shut down due to anti-austerity strike on social media
Nearly all flights are set to be cancelled in Belgium on Monday after the country’s air traffic controller said its staff would take part in a national strike against government austerity measures.

Skeyes, the company responsible for Belgium’s air traffic control, said it would be unable to provide regular services at the country’s airports and in its airspace between 7am (06:00 GMT) and 9pm (20:00 GMT) on Monday.

“The anticipated staffing levels will not allow the safe handling of regular air traffic to be guaranteed during this period,” the company said. “Skeyes is therefore obliged to temporarily suspend the services concerned.”
It added that only essential services for emergencies and other safety-critical flights would continue.

The Brussels-Charleroi airport, a major European hub for low-cost airline Ryanair, said the strike would result in the “complete shutdown of all the country’s airports for an entire day”, affecting thousands of passengers.
“Without air traffic control, no flights can take off or land,” the Brussels-Charleroi airport said, criticising a “last-minute decision” with “disastrous consequences”.
Brussels airport said most departing and arriving flights “will have to be cancelled”.
Belgian unions have called for a nationwide day of action on Monday to protest against austerity and reform measures pursued by the country’s governing coalition.
The Board of Airline Representatives in Belgium, which represents about 25 carriers, said the walkout would be the 11th strike affecting Belgian airspace in 11 months.

The unions also plan a large-scale demonstration in Brussels on Monday. Significant disruption is expected to public transport, while schools, government offices and refuse collection services may also be affected.

Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever has been in protracted talks with his coalition partners on a cost-cutting budget that will save 10 billion euros ($11bn) over the next few years by Monday, in a bid to reduce the country’s high deficit.

Earlier in November, De Wever offered his resignation after his coalition failed to reach a deal. However, Belgium’s King Philippe rejected the resignation and gave the prime minister more time to find a solution.

Polish authorities have said Russian intelligence services tried to kill a Ukrainian-American rapper visiting the country in August, after Copenhagen said Moscow had allegedly targeted the same man on Danish soil.

Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesman Maciej Wewior confirmed the alleged plot to kill Vasiliev in Poland to The Associated Press news agency on Sunday.

On Friday, in response to Denmark’s statement about the alleged assassination plan, Poland’s Foreign Ministry had written, “It is the second assassination attempt against the same person. The first one was foiled on the Polish territory in August 2026.”
It also said that a Russian national had been arrested.
Polish authorities detained the suspect, who was allegedly recruited by Moscow, on August 7.
Denmark announced the expulsion of a Russian diplomat on Friday after it accused Moscow intelligence of plotting the assassination during a concert in a Copenhagen suburb in September.
Denmark’s intelligence agency, PET, said on the same day that it suspected Russia of planning the assassination with the help of a banned Danish gang.
Two Danish men appeared ⁠in court near Copenhagen on Friday, charged with assisting a foreign intelligence service and attempted murder.
Russia dismissed the allegations through its embassy in Copenhagen, saying they were unsubstantiated.

Previously, on August 13, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk disclosed that a plot to kill a Ukrainian-American in Warsaw was thwarted. He did not disclose Vasiliev’s name at the time but said the target “was uncomfortable” for Russian President Vladimir Putin’s government.
Vasiliev has expressed his support for Ukraine amid Russia’s ongoing war on the country and was performing across Europe this year before his concerts were cancelled for security reasons.

Russia’s domestic security service, the FSB, accused Vasiliev of being involved in supplying drones for an alleged Ukrainian attack on a defence enterprise in the Moscow region. It said he was “acting under the patronage” of Ukraine’s internal security service, the SBU.
Danish broadcaster DR reported that Vasiliev denied the FSB accusations.
Danish Minister for Foreign Affairs Lars Lokke Rasmussen told reporters on Friday that Denmark was also considering suspending Schengen visas for Russians.

Choi Kyo-jin says he ‘failed to prepare adequately’ for entrance exams following last-minute scramble to tighten measures
South Korea’s education minister has resigned after an AI-assisted cheating scandal that erupted in the lead-up to key university entrance exams last week.

The country has been gripped by fears of AI-assisted exam cheating since last Sunday, when the top scorer in a national tax accountancy exam confessed to using a miniature camera and smartphone to achieve a near-perfect score, just four days before the crucial university entrance exam, known as the suneung .
The cheat’s confession sent officials scrambling to roll out a slew of preventive measures for the university entrance exams, including blocking public wifi in testing areas.
The unprecedented crackdown included doubling the number of supervisors and sending emergency alerts to detect any smartphones illegally smuggled into the exam centres.
Students were also told to turn up with pencils only. Erasers were provided by the test centres, as authorities tried to reduce the chances of concealed digital devices disguised as stationery.
In addition, exam-takers were asked to avoid wearing clothes with buttons. Those who failed to comply were told they would have stickers placed over the buttons to prevent the use of hidden cameras.
The government promised a reward of at least $75,000 (£57,300) for anyone reporting cheating or misconduct, with reduced penalties for those who turned in their accomplices.
But the education minister, Choi Kyo-jin, struggled to reassure the public, and teachers’ unions criticised the government response as belated.

“The exam concluded without any major incidents … However, as the minister in charge, I do not believe I am immune from public criticism that we failed to prepare adequately in advance,” Choi wrote on X. “Now that the exam is over, I take full responsibility and hereby offer my resignation.”
The president, Lee Jae Myung, accepted his resignation, the presidential office said.

The annual, eight-hour suneung determines which university a candidate can attend and, in turn, their future prospects. It is widely seen as a ticket to prestigious universities, well-paid jobs and even better marriage prospects in the highly competitive country.

Asked during a parliamentary hearing on Monday whether he was confident that authorities could catch would-be cheaters on exam day, Choi, 72, replied: “Due to my age, I am not confident I could.” His response quickly drew a public backlash.
Choi did not appear at press conferences in the days leading up to Thursday’s exam, and a vice-minister instead announced the preventive measures.

The person who cheated in the national tax accountancy exam said in a video posted to his lawyer’s YouTube account that he had photographed the questions with a concealed microcamera, sent them to an AI system and read the answers from a smartphone. “I cheated in the tax accountant exam,” he said. “My top placing is not the result of legitimate effort.”
The scandal has rattled a ‌country where standardised tests largely dictate social mobility and career trajectories.
South Korea’s high-stakes university exams upended by AI cheating scandal

South Korea goes to great lengths to ensure the smooth running of the suneung . Aircraft takeoffs and landings are rescheduled during the 25-minute English listening paper to minimise noise, while artillery fire and tank movements are suspended. The stock market opens an hour late and cars are stopped 200 metres from every centre.

崔教振表示，在最后一刻紧急收紧措施后，他“未能充分准备”入学考试
韩国教育部长在上周关键大学入学考试前爆发的人工智能辅助作弊丑闻后辞职。
自上周日以来，全国一直对人工智能辅助考试作弊感到担忧，当时距离关键的大学入学考试（称为“高考”）仅四天，国家税务会计考试的最高分者承认使用微型相机和智能手机获得了近乎完美的分数。
作弊者的供认促使官员们紧急推出一系列高考预防措施，包括封锁考场的公共无线网络。
这次史无前例的打击行动包括将监管人员数量增加一倍，并发送紧急警报以检测任何非法走私进入考试中心的智能手机。
学生们还被告知只能携带铅笔。考试中心提供了橡皮擦，当局试图减少伪装成文具的隐藏数字设备的可能性。
此外，要求考生避免穿有纽扣的衣服。那些不遵守规定的人被告知，他们将在按钮上贴上贴纸，以防止使用隐藏的摄像头。
政府承诺对举报作弊或不当行为的人给予至少 75,000 美元（57,300 英镑）的奖励，并减轻对举报同谋者的处罚。
但教育部长崔教振（Choi Kyo-jin）努力安抚公众，教师工会批评政府的反应太迟了。
崔在X上写道：“考试没有发生任何重大事件……但是，作为主管部长，我相信我不会免受公众批评我们没有提前做好充分准备的批评。现在考试结束了，我承担全部责任，并在此提出辞职。”
青瓦台表示，总统李在明已接受辞呈。
每年八小时的入学决定了候选人可以进入哪所大学，进而决定了他们的未来前景。人们普遍认为，在这个竞争激烈的国家，它是通往名牌大学、高薪工作甚至更好婚姻前景的门票。
在周一的议会听证会上，当被问及是否有信心当局能够在考试当天抓获潜在作弊者时，72 岁的崔回答说：“由于我的年龄，我不相信自己能做到。”他的回应很快引起了公众的强烈反对。
周四考试前几天，崔顺实没有出席新闻发布会，而是由一位副部长宣布了预防措施。
在国家税务会计考试中作弊的人在其律师的 YouTube 帐户上发布的视频中表示，他用隐藏的微型相机拍摄了问题，将其发送到人工智能系统并从智能手机读取答案。 “我在税务会计师考试中作弊了，”他说。 “我的第一名并不是合法努力的结果。”
这起丑闻让这个国家感到不安，因为标准化考试在很大程度上决定了社会流动性和职业轨迹。

韩国竭尽全力确保“新星”的顺利运行。在25分钟的英语听力试卷期间，飞机的起飞和降落被重新安排，以尽量减少噪音，同时暂停炮火和坦克的移动。股市晚开一个小时，汽车停在距离每个中心 200 米的地方。

title_en: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
title_zh: 民主党在推翻北卡罗来纳州席位后赢得了自 1992 年以来最大的众议院多数席位
summary: Democrats have now won at least 258 seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats.
summary_zh: 民主党目前在中期选举中赢得了至少 258 个席位，而共和党至少拥有 173 个席位。
body_en: The Democratic Party has won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard unseated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina.
The race was called on Sunday, with Hubbard beating Foxx by 330 votes with 99% counted. It was one of the closest contests of the recent midterm elections, in which Democrats also secured the Senate.
The party has now won at least 258 House seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats, with four races still yet to be called.
Neither party had won as many House races since 1992, when Bill Clinton won the presidency and Democrats won a total of 258 seats.

Sunday's result came after Foxx, who has represented North Carolina's 5th Congressional District since 2005, requested a recount. This is allowed under state law when the margin of victory is under 1%.

"I think the American people are just sick of what's going on and they wanted a change. They voted for change," Hubbard told the BBC News Channel after his victory. He pledged to work alongside his fellow lawmakers to hold President Donald Trump accountable.
Earlier, he wrote on X that he had spoken to Foxx, "who graciously conceded following the results of the recount process".

Hubbard added: "I deeply appreciate her commitment to a smooth transition of the office and constituent casework. We may not always agree, but we both love North Carolina and the people of the Fifth District."

Foxx, meanwhile, said in a statement: "After running a campaign focused on my track record of commonsense solutions and conservative values, I'm humbled and grateful that so many North Carolina voters responded by supporting my candidacy, even if we came up just a few votes short."

Hubbard's win, which comes after he lost to Foxx in the 2024 midterms by nine percentage points, followed a number of Democratic victories in deeply Republican districts including South Carolina, Texas, Alaska and Iowa.
Hubbard, like many Democrats running in the midterms, focused on the rising cost of living in the US during the war with Iran - a top issue for voters.
Trump himself - as well as Vice President JD Vance - have suggested inflation caused by the war in Iran was probably to blame for the Republican losses.
Hubbard has also said he will also prioritise working families and small businesses, supporting public education and expanding access to affordable healthcare, according to his website.

The remaining House races yet to be called are in Tennessee and Minnesota, while two elections in Louisiana will go to a runoff in December. In Tennessee's fourth district, Democrat Victoria Broderick leads by fewer than 300 votes, and in Minnesota's first district, Democrat Jake Johnson is winning by fewer than 500 votes.

Democrats may use their upcoming majority in the House and control of the Senate to investigate conflicts of interest and other actions by the president and those close to him, while the Senate also has the power to confirm or block the president's cabinet and judicial nominations. They will also be able to pass legislation through Congress easily, though Trump still has to give final sign off for it to become law.
However, even with control of both chambers of Congress, they will still have limits on their power as Trump can veto legislation.

body_zh: 民主党人查克·哈伯德 (Chuck Hubbard) 在北卡罗来纳州击败共和党众议员弗吉尼亚·福克斯 (Virginia Foxx) 后，民主党自 1992 年以来在美国众议院赢得了最大多数席位。
比赛于周日宣布，哈伯德以 330 票的优势击败福克斯，计票率为 99%。这是最近中期选举中最激烈的竞争之一，民主党也赢得了参议院席位。
该党目前在中期选举中赢得了至少 258 个众议院席位，而共和党至少拥有 173 个席位，而且还有四场比赛尚未揭晓。
自 1992 年比尔·克林顿 (Bill Clinton) 赢得总统职位、民主党总共赢得 258 个席位以来，两党都没有赢得过如此多的众议院选举。
自 2005 年以来一直代表北卡罗来纳州第五国会选区的福克斯要求重新计票，周日的结果公布。当胜率低于 1% 时，州法律允许这样做。
“我认为美国人民只是厌倦了正在发生的事情，他们想要改变。他们投票支持改变，”哈伯德在获胜后告诉英国广播公司新闻频道。他承诺与其他议员一起努力追究唐纳德·特朗普总统的责任。
早些时候，他在 X 上写道，他已与福克斯交谈过，“福克斯在重新计票结果出来后慷慨地承认了这一点”。
哈伯德补充道：“我深深感谢她对办公室和选民案件顺利过渡的承诺。我们可能并不总是同意，但我们都热爱北卡罗来纳州和第五选区的人民。”
与此同时，福克斯在一份声明中表示：“在以我的常识性解决方案和保守价值观的记录为重点开展竞选活动后，我感到谦卑和感激，有这么多北卡罗来纳州选民支持我的候选资格，即使我们只差了几票。”
哈伯德在 2024 年中期选举中以 9 个百分点的优势输给福克斯后，取得了胜利，此前民主党在南卡罗来纳州、德克萨斯州、阿拉斯加和爱荷华州等共和党占多数的选区取得了一系列胜利。
与许多参加中期选举的民主党人一样，哈伯德关注的是伊朗战争期间美国生活成本上升——这是选民面临的首要问题。
特朗普本人以及副总统万斯表示，伊朗战争造成的通货膨胀可能是共和党失败的原因。
据哈伯德网站称，他还表示，他还将优先考虑工薪家庭和小企业，支持公共教育并扩大获得负担得起的医疗保健的机会。
其余尚未公布的众议院选举将在田纳西州和明尼苏达州举行，而路易斯安那州的两场选举将于 12 月进行决选。在田纳西州第四选区，民主党人维多利亚·布罗德里克 (Victoria Broderick) 以不到 300 票的优势领先，在明尼苏达州第一选区，民主党人杰克·约翰逊 (Jake Johnson) 以不到 500 票的优势获胜。
民主党可能会利用即将在众议院的多数席位和对参议院的控制权来调查总统及其亲信的利益冲突和其他行为，而参议院也有权确认或阻止总统的内阁和司法提名。他们还能够轻松地在国会通过立法，尽管特朗普仍需最终签署才能使其成为法律。
然而，即使控制了国会两院，他们的权力仍然受到限制，因为特朗普可以否决立法。

title_en: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
title_zh: COP31未能达成重大气候协议，谈判暴露出深刻分歧
summary: Hopes for an agreement on tackling climate change collapsed after a row about mentioning fossil fuels
summary_zh: 在有关化石燃料的争论之后，达成应对气候变化协议的希望破灭了
body_en: By Mark Poynting, Esme Stallard and Justin Rowlatt
Countries have failed to reach a major new deal to tackle climate change after deep divisions over fossil fuels and money emerged at the UN COP31 talks in Turkey.
Negotiations were due to finish on Friday but ran late into Sunday in search of common ground, becoming the longest UN climate conference in history.
But the final deal proved unacceptable to the EU, Pacific island nations and others because it failed to directly mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.
Meanwhile, many poorer countries objected to the absence of any clear financial commitments from richer nations to help them adapt to the impacts of rising temperatures.
The last time a COP's main political agreement collapsed like this was in 2009 in Copenhagen.
UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres, in his last COP before he steps down, said he was "deeply disappointed".

He took aim at what he called "powerful fossil fuel interests" who he said were taking "a page from Big Tobacco's playbook: distorting the science, delaying policy, blocking action, and piling up huge profits while people everywhere pay the price".
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, whose country co-hosted the talks, attributed the failure to "difficult geopolitical times".
After two weeks of negotiations, exhausted delegates were presented with a new, draft deal in the early hours of Sunday to try to break the deadlock.

But the words "fossil fuels" did not appear anywhere in the text. The only indirect reference to coal, oil and gas was a nod to a deal agreed at COP28 in 2023 , when countries agreed to "transition away" from fossil fuels in energy systems.

The EU's representative, Irish Minister Darragh O'Brien, made it clear that the EU "strongly" objected, saying that the "decisions go nowhere near the level of ambition needed to tackle climate change".
"It is unconscionable that we would have a climate pact that makes no mention of fossil fuels," he said.
Other countries, such as Panama and the Marshall Islands, also criticised the deal for doing nowhere near enough to tackle the pace of climate change.
A first draft of the deal on Monday mentioned "fossil fuel" or "fossil fuels" six times, but that was unacceptable to oil-producing nations.
Saudi Arabia's delegate Mohammad Ayoub said that Arab countries "continued to engage in good faith" but argued that they only accounted for a small proportion of historical greenhouse gas emissions.
Russia warned not to "turn to slogans" over coal, oil and gas, claiming that if countries moved away from fossil fuels too quickly it would lead to "fuel poverty".
Another major sticking point has been money for poorer countries to adapt to the impacts of climate change, such as more intense heatwaves and more severe droughts.
Last year at COP30 in Brazil , nations agreed to triple the finance for that purpose.
But this year's deal contained no reference to concrete figures, nor the baseline against which that pledge would be measured. This raised fears it would give richer nations too much wriggle room.
body_zh: 作者：马克·坡印廷、埃斯梅·斯塔拉德和贾斯汀·罗拉特
在土耳其举行的联合国 COP31 会议上，各国在化石燃料和资金问题上出现了深刻分歧，但未能就应对气候变化达成重大新协议。
谈判原定于周五结束，但为了寻求共同点而拖延至周日，成为历史上最长的联合国气候会议。
但最终的协议被证明是欧盟、太平洋岛国和其他国家无法接受的，因为它没有直接提及化石燃料，而化石燃料是全球变暖的主要原因。
与此同时，许多较贫穷国家反对富裕国家没有做出任何明确的财政承诺来帮助它们适应气温上升的影响。
上一次缔约方会议的主要政治协议像这样崩溃是在 2009 年的哥本哈根。
联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在卸任前的最后一次缔约方会议上表示，他“深感失望”。
他把目标瞄准了他所谓的“强大的化石燃料利益集团”，他说这些利益集团正在“效仿大烟草公司的做法：歪曲科学、拖延政策、阻碍行动、积累巨额利润，而世界各地的人们却为此付出了代价”。
共同主办此次会谈的澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞将此次失败归咎于“地缘政治困难时期”。
经过两周的谈判，疲惫不堪的代表们在周日凌晨收到了一份新的协议草案，试图打破僵局。
但“化石燃料”一词并未出现在案文中的任何地方。唯一间接提到煤炭、石油和天然气的是对 2023 年 COP28 上达成的一项协议的认可，当时各国同意在能源系统中“放弃”化石燃料。
欧盟代表爱尔兰部长达拉·奥布莱恩明确表示欧盟“强烈”反对，并表示“这些决定远未达到应对气候变化所需的雄心水平”。
他说：“我们制定的气候协议中没有提及化石燃料，这是不合理的。”
巴拿马和马绍尔群岛等其他国家也批评该协议在应对气候变化方面做得还不够。
周一该协议的初稿六次提到“化石燃料”或“化石燃料”，但这对于产油国来说是不可接受的。
沙特阿拉伯代表穆罕默德·阿尤布表示，阿拉伯国家“继续真诚地参与”，但辩称它们只占历史温室气体排放量的一小部分。
俄罗斯警告不要在煤炭、石油和天然气问题上“诉诸口号”，声称如果各国过快摆脱化石燃料，将导致“燃料贫困”。
另一个主要症结是为较贫穷国家提供资金以适应气候变化的影响，例如更强烈的热浪和更严重的干旱。
去年在巴西举行的第三十次缔约方大会上，各国同意将为此目的提供的资金增加两倍。
但今年的协议没有提及具体数字，也没有提及衡量这一承诺的基准。这引发了人们的担忧，这会给富裕国家带来太多的回旋余地。

The World ‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌Health Organization (WHO) chief has urged peace following heavy fighting in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s (DRC) northeastern province, the epicentre of the Ebola outbreak.

WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠on ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠Sunday that fighting near a hospital in the DRC’s Ituri ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠province disrupted Ebola response efforts and forced health workers and aid partners to shelter ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠inside a maternity ward for more than 24 hours.

“Heavy fighting has been ongoing since yesterday in the vicinity of a hospital in Ituri – in an area close to where the Ebola outbreak first emerged,” Tedros said on X.
“The situation has disrupted the work of the hospital and the wider Ebola response, putting patients, families and health workers at grave risk.”

Medical staff have been sheltering for their lives in a maternity ward in the facility for more than 24 hours, and the WHO is working to arrange a safe exit for the team and “for the hospital facilities, staff and patients to be protected,” Tedros also said.
As of November 17, the WHO reported a total of 5,678 deaths out of 11,613 cases in the DRC, the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country.
The WHO said in a statement on Saturday that “while some areas had seen a slight decline in cases, sustained, high-level transmission continues overall in the country.”
Ituri and North Kivu, in the eastern part of the DRC, remain the most affected provinces.
The virus, which is transmitted through contact with bodily fluids, has spread across swaths of the DRC’s east and northeast, which have been plagued by violence for more than 30 years.

Earlier in November, armed men thought to be linked to an ISIL (ISIS)-affiliated group raided villages and killed dozens of people in North Kivu, forcing ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠patients with confirmed and suspected Ebola infections to flee.

The outbreak is also occurring amid ongoing fighting between government forces and the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group, which has seized key cities in eastern DRC, making transport of healthcare resources to remote regions difficult.

世界卫生组织（WHO）总干事敦促在埃博拉疫情中心刚果民主共和国（DRC）东北部省份发生激烈战斗后实现和平。
世卫组织总干事谭德塞周日表示，刚果民主共和国伊图里省一家医院附近的战斗扰乱了埃博拉应对工作，迫使卫生工作者和援助伙伴在产房内避难超过 24 小时。

谭德塞在 X 台上表示：“自昨天以来，伊图里一家医院附近一直在发生激烈战斗，该地区靠近埃博拉疫情首次爆发的地区。”
“这种情况扰乱了医院的工作和更广泛的埃博拉应对工作，使患者、家人和卫生工作者面临严重风险。”
谭德塞还表示，医务人员已经在该设施的产科病房中避难超过24小时，世界卫生组织正在努力为医疗队安排安全出口，“以保护医院设施、工作人员和患者”。
截至 11 月 17 日，世界卫生组织报告刚果民主共和国共有 11,613 例病例，其中 5,678 人死亡，这是该国规模最大、死亡人数最多的埃博拉疫情。
世界卫生组织在周六的一份声明中表示，“虽然一些地区的病例略有下降，但该国总体上持续、高水平的传播仍在继续。”
刚果民主共和国东部的伊图里和北基伍省仍然是受影响最严重的省份。
该病毒通过体液接触传播，已在刚果民主共和国东部和东北部的大片地区传播，这些地区30多年来一直饱受暴力事件的困扰。
11 月初，据信与伊斯兰国 (ISIS) 附属组织有联系的武装人员袭击了北基伍省的村庄并杀害了数十人，迫使确诊和疑似埃博拉病毒感染者逃离。
疫情爆发之际，政府军与卢旺达支持的“M23”武装组织之间持续交战，该组织占领了刚果民主共和国东部的主要城市，导致向偏远地区运送医疗资源变得困难。

title_en: Asian stock markets tumble as AI bubble fears mount
title_zh: 随着人工智能泡沫担忧加剧，亚洲股市暴跌
summary: Stocks fall in South Korea, Taiwan, mainland China and Hong Kong as tech sell-off deepens.

Asian stock markets have opened to sharp losses amid mounting concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom.
Markets in South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong and mainland China sank deeper into the red on Monday, continuing Friday’s tech-led sell-off on both sides of the Pacific.

The Korea Composite Stock Price Index (Kospi) in Seoul slid as much as 5.8 percent, while Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index fell 1.8 percent.

The CSI 300 Index in Shanghai dropped more than 1.3 percent, while the Taiwan Stock Exchange Capitalization Weighted Stock Index (Taiex) in Taipei swung between losses and gains after falling more than 1 percent at opening.
Japan’s stock markets were closed for Labour Thanksgiving Day.
Following Friday’s rout in Asia, Wall Street’s benchmark S&P 500 closed 3.7 percent lower to enter a correction – the term investors use when the market drops 10 percent or more from its recent high.
The tech-focused Nasdaq Composite, roughly half of which is made up of the “Magnificent Seven” AI-oriented firms, dropped 5.3 percent to erase all of its gains for 2026.
The Kospi, Nikkei 225, and the Taiex entered the weekend between 5.1 percent and 6.2 percent lower, while the Hang Seng Index finished down 1.9 percent.
Wall Street appeared on track for a rebound on Monday, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures up 2 percent and 2.4 percent, respectively.
After last week’s losses, investors are trying to assess if the market correction has “gone too far”, said Rajat Agarwal, an Asia equity strategist with Societe Generale.
“I think markets are trying to find some ground after a massive sell-off in [the] US on Friday, a more than a three-standard-deviation event in tech indices,” Agarwal told Al Jazeera.
Investors have long been concerned that tech firms may not be able to sustain the multi-trillion-dollar investments they have poured into the infrastructure needed to train and run AI.
Global AI-related investment, much of it fuelled by debt, is expected to reach $2.7 trillion in 2026 and $3.6 trillion in 2027, according to technology insights company Gartner.
Concerns that the AI boom may be running out of steam have been exacerbated by growing calls for greater oversight of the sector.

The Democratic Party’s sweeping victory in the US midterm elections is expected to slow data centre construction in US states, while the alleged espionage scandal embroiling chip giant Nvidia and its former CEO Jensen Huang has led to a push for tighter restrictions on China’s access to advanced chips.

以科技为重点的纳斯达克综合指数下跌了 5.3%，抹去了 2026 年的全部涨幅，其中大约一半由“七大”人工智能公司组成。

投资者长期以来一直担心科技公司可能无法维持在训练和运行人工智能所需的基础设施上投入的数万亿美元投资。
根据技术洞察公司 Gartner 的数据，全球人工智能相关投资（其中大部分由债务推动）预计到 2026 年将达到 2.7 万亿美元，到 2027 年将达到 3.6 万亿美元。
越来越多的人呼吁加强对该行业的监管，这加剧了人们对人工智能繁荣可能失去动力的担忧。
民主党在美国中期选举中的压倒性胜利预计将放缓美国各州的数据中心建设速度，而芯片巨头英伟达及其前首席执行官黄仁勋涉嫌间谍丑闻导致对中国获取先进芯片的更严格限制。

title_en: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing
title_zh: 旧金山正在享受人工智能的繁荣，但对崩溃的担忧也在增加
summary: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.
summary_zh: 该行业中心旧金山的人工智能员工担心该行业过热。
body_en: Image source, San Francisco Travel Association
Technology reporter , Reporting from San Francisco
Lauren Goldboss is busy. The owner of a small San Francisco dog-walking company, she has been hiring staff and buying vans.
Fuelling the growth is her new office dog-walking service Paw Perk, popular with some local AI start-ups.
Her business is an example of how the AI boom in San Francisco is benefiting other sectors.
The city saw an exodus of residents during the pandemic and its downtown was weakened by remote work, but it s now enjoying a rejuvenation, with AI being the major driver.

Leading AI firms OpenAI and Anthropic – which have been hiring top engineering talent, often on eye-popping salaries – are based here. Anthropic, the company behind the Claude chatbot, last week listed on New York's Nasdaq stock exchange.
Thousands of other AI start-ups have also sprung up , external in San Francisco.
Signs of the boom are evident in soaring rents and house prices, falling office vacancies, and buses and billboards plastered with cryptic AI adverts.

But what if there is a significant downward correction in AI share prices and a resulting big fall in investment in the industry? The International Monetary Fund last month became the latest organization to warn , external that this was a possibility.

Concerns have since continued due to the scandal surrounding Jensen Huang, the former boss of AI firm Nvidia, based south of San Francisco, causing some wider AI stock falls. However, Nvidia remains highly profitable, and Wednesday of this week it reported that its latest quarterly profits had doubled from a year earlier to $65bn (£49bn).
Simon Jack: Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?
The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
Wealthy AI workers send San Francisco house prices soaring
Follow the money: Who pays for the AI boom now?
What are the thoughts of AI workers in the city, and should San Francisco – no stranger to tech's boom-and-bust cycles – be preparing for a possible crash?

One AI worker, employed by one of the largest companies in the city, is convinced that a crash is coming. "I am certain that the house of cards will come down… and I'm sure it will affect me," says the man who asked that we didn't use his name.
He questions whether leading US AI companies can generate enough revenues to justify their enormous spending commitments as cheaper, increasingly capable AI models emerge, especially from China.
But he isn't losing sleep over it. "Why worry about things I can't control?"
Another San Francisco-based AI worker, who also asked to remain anonymous, says that a significant market correction is "totally possible".
body_zh: 图片来源，旧金山旅游协会
科技记者，旧金山报道
劳伦·戈德博斯很忙。她是旧金山一家小型遛狗公司的老板，一直在招聘员工和购买货车。
她新推出的办公室遛狗服务 Paw Perk 推动了这一增长，该服务受到一些当地人工智能初创企业的欢迎。
她的生意是旧金山人工智能热潮如何惠及其他行业的一个例子。
在大流行期间，这座城市出现了大批居民外流，市中心因远程工作而受到削弱，但现在正在经历复兴，人工智能是主要驱动力。
领先的人工智能公司 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 都总部设在这里，它们一直在招聘顶尖的工程人才，薪水往往令人瞠目结舌。 Anthropic 是 Claude 聊天机器人背后的公司，上周在纽约纳斯达克证券交易所上市。
旧金山外部也涌现出数千家其他人工智能初创企业。
租金和房价飙升、办公室空置率下降、公交车和广告牌上贴满了神秘的人工智能广告，都是繁荣的迹象。
但如果人工智能股价大幅下调并导致该行业投资大幅下降怎么办？国际货币基金组织上个月成为最新一个对外发出警告的组织，称存在这种可能性。
此后，由于围绕位于旧金山南部的人工智能公司英伟达(Nvidia)前老板黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)的丑闻，人们的担忧持续不断，导致人工智能股票出现更广泛的下跌。然而，英伟达仍然保持高利润，本周周三报告称，其最新季度利润较上年同期翻了一番，达到 650 亿美元（490 亿英镑）。
Simon Jack：Anthropic 破纪录的 IPO 能否阻止人工智能泡沫破裂？
黄仁勋的兴衰——科技巨星如何深陷丑闻
富有的人工智能工作者推动旧金山房价飙升
追随金钱：现在谁为人工智能的繁荣买单？
这座城市的人工智能工作者有什么想法？旧金山——对科技的繁荣与萧条周期并不陌生——是否应该为可能的崩溃做好准备？
一名受雇于该市最大公司之一的人工智能员工确信崩溃即将到来。 “我确信纸牌屋会倒塌……而且我确信它会影响到我，”那位要求我们不透露姓名的男子说道。
他质疑，随着更便宜、能力越来越强的人工智能模型（尤其是来自中国的人工智能模型）的出现，美国领先的人工智能公司是否能够产生足够的收入来证明其巨额支出承诺是合理的。
但他并没有因此而失眠。 “为什么要担心我无法控制的事情呢？”
另一位也要求保持匿名的旧金山人工智能工作者表示，市场大幅调整是“完全有可能的”。

title_en: Burnham to tell MPs 'landmark' EU deal could make next decade 'much better'
title_zh: 伯纳姆告诉国会议员“具有里程碑意义的”欧盟协议可能会让下一个十年“变得更好”
summary: The prime minister will tell MPs the deal agreed on Friday is a "choice between a broken status quo or change".
summary_zh: 总理将告诉国会议员，周五达成的协议是“打破现状或改变之间的选择”。
body_en: By Nick Eardley , Political correspondent and Matt Spivey
The prime minister will tell Parliament on Monday the "landmark" deal struck with the EU means there is a "very real prospect" the next decade can be "much better" than the last one.
The deal is a "choice between a broken status quo or change", Andy Burnham will tell MPs.
He will also call it "the single biggest growth measure to be delivered in this parliament" - repeating his claim it could add £17bn to the British economy.

The PM described it on Friday as a "win-win" deal with the EU on British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme. But since then a host of politicians have criticised the plan, with one former prime minister urging him to "move on" from Brexit.
Burnham believes the agreement reached in Brussels "holds out the very real prospect that the next decade can be a much better one for Britain than the one we have just lived through".
"The ability to draw a line on a decade of drift and division is in our hands and I believe we should take it," he will say in his speech.
He will also paint the move as a choice "between easing pressure on the cost of living or allowing food prices to rise further" and "creating opportunities for young people or denying them".
He believes polling suggests the UK public "want closer ties" with the EU and the deal "delivers that".
But his announcement on Friday was greeted with a chorus of criticism from a number of opposing political figures.
Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch said the deal was unfair because UK farmers would now have to follow rules made by Brussels.
She questioned the Treasury's analysis, which Burnham said suggested the deal "will add up to 0.5%" to UK gross domestic product and he described it as a "£17bn boost to the British economy".
Badenoch accused him of having "plucked that figure out of the air" before saying "the only modelling I've seen that even talks about that figure says it's actually 0.0%".

Meanwhile Reform UK leader Farage called the deal a "very good day for the EU", before adding: "A good day to try and humiliate the one member state that actually had the courage to say, 'We don't need to be part of you, we can govern our own country'."

Farage, who was a leading figure in the 2016 campaign to get Britain out of the EU, added in a social media post: "Like every prime minister before him, Burnham is a total fraud. Only Reform will stop the endless betrayal of the British people."
Over the weekend former prime ministers including Theresa May, Sir Tony Blair and Rishi Sunak also criticised the EU-UK deal.
May, who presided over three years of Brexit negotiations during her premiership, said she was "aghast" by the deal and warned Andy Burnham should "move on".
Sir Tony, who was a prominent opponent of leaving the EU, told The Sunday Times Britain should only rejoin the EU if it reforms, and allows more innovation on technology.
Badenoch will use her speech at the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) annual conference on Monday to criticise Burnham's EU deal.
She will accuse the prime minister of securing a "terrible" deal and will say he should be "aiming a lot higher" in terms of driving growth.
body_zh: 作者：尼克·厄德利（Nick Eardley），政治记者和马特·斯皮维（Matt Spivey）
首相将于周一告诉议会，与欧盟达成的“里程碑式”协议意味着未来十年“非常现实的前景”可能比上一个十年“好得多”。
安迪·伯纳姆将告诉国会议员，这笔交易是“打破现状或改变之间的选择”。
他还将称其为“本届议会将采取的最大的单一增长措施”——重申他的说法，这将为英国经济增加 170 亿英镑。
英国首相周五将其描述为与欧盟就英国食品出口、排放交易和青年体验计划达成的“双赢”协议。但自那以后，许多政界人士批评了该计划，一位前首相敦促他“继续”脱欧。
伯纳姆认为，在布鲁塞尔达成的协议“展现了非常真实的前景，即下一个十年对英国来说可能比我们刚刚经历的十年要好得多”。
他在演讲中表示：“我们有能力划清十年的漂移和分裂界限，我相信我们应该接受它。”
他还将此举描述为“在缓解生活成本压力或允许食品价格进一步上涨之间”和“为年轻人创造机会或拒绝他们”之间的选择。
他认为民意调查显示英国公众“希望与欧盟建立更紧密的联系”，而该协议“实现了这一目标”。
但他周五的声明遭到了一些反对派政治人物的齐声批评。
保守党领袖凯米·巴德诺克表示，这项协议不公平，因为英国农民现在必须遵守布鲁塞尔制定的规则。
她对财政部的分析提出质疑，伯纳姆称该分析表明该协议“将为英国国内生产总值增加0.5%”，他将其描述为“为英国经济带来170亿英镑的提振”。
巴德诺克指责他“凭空捏造了这个数字”，然后说“我见过的唯一一个甚至谈论这个数字的模型说它实际上是 0.0%”。
与此同时，英国改革党领导人法拉奇称该协议“对欧盟来说是非常好的一天”，然后补充道：“这是一个试图羞辱真正有勇气说‘我们不需要成为你们的一部分，我们可以管理自己国家’的成员国的好日子。”
法拉奇是2016年英国脱欧运动的主要人物，他在社交媒体帖子中补充道：“像他之前的每一位首相一样，伯纳姆完全是个骗子。只有改革才能制止对英国人民无休止的背叛。”
周末，包括特蕾莎·梅、托尼·布莱尔爵士和里希·苏纳克在内的前首相也批评了欧盟与英国的协议。
在担任首相期间主持了三年脱欧谈判的梅表示，她对该协议感到“震惊”，并警告安迪·伯纳姆应该“继续前进”。
托尼爵士是英国脱欧的著名反对者，他告诉《星期日泰晤士报》，英国只有在进行改革并允许更多技术创新的情况下才应该重新加入欧盟。
巴德诺克将于周一在英国工业联合会（CBI）年会上发表讲话，批评伯纳姆的欧盟协议。
她将指责总理达成了一项“糟糕”的协议，并表示他应该在推动经济增长方面“设定更高的目标”。

body_zh: 以色列反对派领导人加迪·艾森科特周日谴责定居者对约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦村庄的纵火袭击，称其为“犹太恐怖主义”。以色列警方表示，他们对袭击事件展开调查，近一个月前，一场没有结果的选举导致现任总理内塔尼亚胡失去了多数席位。
